scenario:
A national geospatial data agency is developing an enterprise-level data management system to handle detailed geographic and administrative data related to postal codes. This system is designed to provide comprehensive insights into the spatial distribution of postal codes and their corresponding administrative areas, health authority regions, and geographic coordinates. The platform will support urban planning, resource allocation, and public health management by offering precise geospatial data.

The system will manage detailed information about postal codes, including positional quality indicators, geographic coordinates (eastings and northings), and administrative codes for counties, districts, and wards. It will also integrate with health authority codes, linking each postal code to relevant NHS health regions. Advanced data analytics and visualization tools will be available to assess geographic data for trends and patterns.

The platform will feature a robust user management system with access controls for data scientists, urban planners, and public health officials. It will enable dynamic querying and reporting to support decision-making processes in urban development and health service provisioning. Additionally, the system will maintain historical data to analyze changes over time and ensure data integrity through version control mechanisms.
